_note: B-62. The only scripts the DeviceOps levers can run, one per lever. A step list is what a person approves; sha256 pins script_id, version and steps (script_id, version, then each step, joined by newlines). The steps are plain-language descriptions: the mock RMM runs none of them and no real script is stored here.

steps: Stop the Print Spooler service
Remove the stuck jobs from the spool folder
Start the Print Spooler service
Confirm the service is Running, healthy, and the queue is empty
Read the saved path of the named drive letter from the device
Disconnect the stale mapping
Reconnect the saved path in the user's own session
Confirm the drive letter reports Connected
Close Outlook for the named user
Rename the user's Outlook profile data to a dated backup name
Leave a new profile to be built at the next Outlook start
Confirm the profile is marked Reset and the backup name is recorded
List the files in the temp folders that are older than 7 days
Move them to a dated quarantine folder; nothing is deleted
Confirm no stale bytes are left and the quarantine holds them
Check the service is on the approved list and exists on the device
Restart the named service
Confirm the service is Running and healthy
Check the device is a workstation and online
Restart the workstation
Confirm a new boot time is reported and no restart is pending
Check the device is a server and online
Restart the server
Confirm a new boot time is reported and no restart is pending
